# Preparation

## Prerequisites

This script was run with the *conda environment* `r_scrnaseq_core`.

```{r}
#| label: chunk-02-packages

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(here)
library(knitr)

```

```{r}
#| label: chunk-03-directories
##  Set directories ------------------------------------------------------------

# Get string of home directory. I used the here package, which sets the home
# directory when loading library(here)
dir_home <- here::here()

## Manuscript figure directory 
# This actually is the only directory I need to specify for this script; I both
# stored all grob .rds files in here and the final figures can end up there
dir_man <- file.path(dir_home, "results/figures/manuscript")
```


## Helper functions

<details>

<summary>*Click here to view the helper functions of this document*</summary>

### save_figure()

`save_figure()` is specific for manuscript figures.

```{r}
#| label: chunk-05-helper-save-plot
save_figure <- function(p, filename, width = 17, height = 20, unit = "cm") {
  ## Save image on disk as png and pdf
  file_png <- file.path(dir_man, paste0(filename, ".png"))
  ggsave(file_png, p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 150, units = unit)
  file_pdf <- file.path(dir_man, paste0(filename, ".pdf"))
  ggsave(file_pdf, p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 150, units = unit)

}
```

### load_rds()

Loads the .rds files from disk

```{r}
#| label: chunk-06-helper-load-rds
load_rds <- function(figure = NULL) {
  file_rds <- file.path(dir_man, paste0(figure, ".rds"))
  readRDS(file_rds)
}

```

</details>

# Figures for manuscript

## Figure 3

```{r}
#| label: chunk-07-load-grobs-fig3

p_f3a <- load_rds("F3A")
p_f3b <- load_rds("F3B")

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-01-assemble-fig3
patch <- free(wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f3a)) | wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f3b)
patch
```

```{r}
#| label: chunk-08-save-fig3
```

## Figure 4

```{r}
#| label: chunk-09-load-grobs-fig4

p_f4a <- load_rds("F4A")
p_f4b <- load_rds("F4B")
p_f4c <- load_rds("F4C")
p_f4dk <- load_rds("F4DK")
p_f4l <- load_rds("F4L")
p_f4m <- load_rds("F4M")

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-02-assemble-fig4
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 16
    
patch_topleft <- (wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f4a) | wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f4b)) +
                    plot_layout(guides = "collect")

patch_top <- (wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f4a) | wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f4b) | 
                wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f4c)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1, 1, 1))

patch_bottom <- (wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f4l) | wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f4m)) +
  plot_layout(axes = "collect", widths = c(1, 1.2))

patch <- (patch_top / p_f4dk / patch_bottom) + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.8, 1.2, 0.6))
patch
```

```{r}
#| label: chunk-10-save-fig4
save_figure(patch, "mrp_fig4", height = 20)
```

## Figure 5

```{r}
#| label: chunk-11-load-grobs-fig5
p_f5a <- load_rds("F5A")
p_f5b <- load_rds("F5B")
p_f5c <- load_rds("F5C")
p_f5d <- load_rds("F5D")
p_f5e <- load_rds("F5E")
p_f5f <- load_rds("F5F")
p_f5g <- load_rds("F5G")
p_f5g_umap <- load_rds("F5G_umap")
p_f5h <- load_rds("F5H")
p_f5h_umap <- load_rds("F5H_umap")
p_f5leg <- load_rds("F5legend")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-03-assemble-fig5
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 16
# a and c as wrap_elements, as they are not gglots anymore due to facetting
patch_pca <- (wrap_elements(full = p_f5a) | wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f5b)) + 
  plot_layout(widths = c(3, 1))
    
patch_umap <- (wrap_elements(full = p_f5c) | wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f5d)) + 
  plot_layout(widths = c(3, 1))

# I had to wrap the bottom seperately, so it spans the full widht, otherwise
# it stops to leave whitespace where the legends of B and D are
patch_bottom <- wrap_elements(full = (
  wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f5e) | wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f5f) | 
  wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f5g) | wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f5g_umap) |
  wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f5h) | wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f5h_umap)
  ) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1, 2, 1, 2)))

patch <- (patch_pca / patch_umap / patch_bottom / wrap_elements(full = p_f5leg)) +
  plot_layout(heights = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 0.4), c("null", "null", "null", "cm")))
patch
```

```{r}
#| label: chunk-12-save-fig5
save_figure(patch, "mrp_fig5", height = 17)
```

## Figure 6

```{r}
#| label: chunk-13-load-grobs-fig6
p_f6a <- load_rds("F6A")
p_f6b <- load_rds("F6B")
p_f6c <- load_rds("F6C")
p_f6d <- load_rds("F6D")
p_f6e <- load_rds("F6E")
p_f6f <- load_rds("F6F")
p_f6g <- load_rds("F6G")
p_f6h <- load_rds("F6H")
p_f6i <- load_rds("F6I")
p_f6j <- load_rds("F6J")
p_6leg <- load_rds("F6legend")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-04-assemble-fig6
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 18

patch_top <- (wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f6a) | wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f6b)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")

# Create a middle patch for the summary plots, so I can make it a little bigger
patch_middle <- wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f6c) | wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f6d)

patch_bottom <- (wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f6e) | wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f6f)) /
  (wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f6g) | wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f6h)) /
  (wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f6i) | wrap_ggplot_grob(p_f6j))


patch <- (wrap_elements(p_6leg) / patch_top / 
            patch_middle / patch_bottom) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = unit(c(0.1, 0.4, 0.45, 1.2), c("cm", "null", "null", "null"))
    )

patch
```

```{r}
#| label: chunk-14-save-fig6
save_figure(patch, "mrp_fig6", height = 23.5)
```
